classification: Binance final-BAR settlement correction, host-boot recovery and one dependency advisory

delta.bar_edge_change: a freshly closed Binance bar is read until two consecutive reads return an identical row and the bar is at least six seconds old; exactly that venue row is published and nothing is merged or invented
delta.defect: Binance kline replicas disagree about a closed bar for about five seconds; the edge read once at close + 0.10s and never revised, so a durable bar could stay short on volume and trade count for ever

venue_comparison.method: field-by-field against the venues' own public REST klines for the same close times

rust_gate.cargo_deny: advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok

python_suite.note: the same four errors occur on a pristine dev worktree

boundaries: This patch inherits the v2.0.14 certificate and does not recertify the full product matrix.
The venue comparison covers the 1m interval for four instruments; other intervals inherit the existing OHLCV certification.
The published close-to-final-BAR availability figure of p50 2.151s no longer describes Binance and must be re-measured before it is quoted.
The deployed qdl-v2-rust:2.0.12-3f1c50e still contains rustls 0.23.43; the source is fixed and the Rust runtime rollout is a separate packet.
Only binance_bar_edge was recreated. V1, Kafka topology, Redis, SQLite, every other role, Trading System and alpha were untouched.
